tasks.title: Normalize tool lifecycle projection
tasks.description: Refactor transcript assembly so raw tool lifecycle events become one logical tool part per provider call or correlation key. The assembler should merge start/update fragments, normalize status, infer useful tool names/titles, and hide internal lifecycle events from visible transcript output.
acceptanceCriteria: A persisted session with tool_call plus tool_call_update for the same call id produces exactly one ToolPart
Update-only or no-id tool payloads merge with pending tools by normalized name plus target/title when inferable
Internal step, lifecycle, or bookkeeping events do not render as visible tool parts
Inferable payloads no longer render as orphan `unknown running...` entries
Backend tests cover id-based merge, no-id correlation, update-only fallback, status normalization, and hidden internal events
Tests pass: cd packages/cli && npm test
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This produces the canonical normalized tool lifecycle behavior consumed by all later API, live, and UI work. Keep existing transcript fields backward-compatible while adding normalized fields or warnings as needed.

tasks.title: Expose canonical transcript metadata
tasks.description: Update the coder session detail API to expose the canonical normalized transcript and metadata needed by the session page. The endpoint should preserve existing callers while returning warnings, changed-file summaries, stable tool statuses, and raw-debug data only behind explicit fields.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/issues/:number/coder-sessions/:sessionId returns normalized turns with merged tool parts from the assembler
The response includes transcript warnings, hasUnknownTools, event/tool/turn counts, lastActivityAt, and changedFiles when available
The endpoint reads session_stream_log first and falls back to workflow_log stream events for legacy sessions
Running sessions do not expose misleading terminal completedAt metadata
API tests prove completed sessions replay from persisted data without SSE state
Existing coder session list consumers remain compatible
Tests pass: cd packages/cli && npm test
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes the canonical assembler output from T-001 and makes it the API contract for historical replay and frontend rendering.

tasks.title: Align live updates with canonical transcript
tasks.description: Refactor live SSE handling so the session page updates the same normalized transcript shape returned by the API. Live tool start/update events must update existing logical tool parts instead of appending duplicate or orphan cards, then reconcile with the canonical detail response after terminal events.
acceptanceCriteria: Live coder_tool_call start/update events merge into one visible tool card when ids or correlation fields match
A running session shows only real active tools as running and does not create orphan unknown cards during streaming
Terminal completion, failure, timeout, cancellation, and recovery events invalidate or refetch the session detail transcript
Live append followed by refetch preserves equivalent visible transcript order and tool grouping for representative fixtures
Near-bottom auto-scroll and away-from-bottom new-content behavior still work for text and tool updates
Frontend tests cover live duplicate prevention and refetch convergence
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: The API transcript from T-002 remains authoritative; live state should be an optimistic incremental view that converges after refetch.

tasks.title: Render semantic tool conversation parts
tasks.description: Update the transcript renderer and tool cards to consume normalized ToolPart data directly and present tools as readable assistant parts. Context tools should group compactly, bash should show command/status/output preview, file-changing tools should show changed-file summaries, and raw payloads should stay collapsed by default.
acceptanceCriteria: Consecutive read, grep, glob, list, search, and memory-read tools render as a compact Gathered context group with expandable details
Bash tool cards show a human title, command, terminal status, duration when available, concise output preview, and expandable full output
Edit, write, and apply_patch tool cards show changed file count, operation, path, additions/deletions when available, and expandable raw patch/input/output
Unknown tools use displayTitle, title, target, source name, or another useful fallback before showing unknown
Pending/running tools use a restrained active state and do not expose half-formed raw payloads as the primary content
Frontend tests cover context grouping, bash summary, apply_patch summary, edit/write summary, unknown fallback, and raw detail disclosure
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes normalized API/live ToolPart fields from T-002 and T-003. Grouping is presentation-only; do not remove individual tool parts from transcript data.

tasks.title: Polish conversation transcript page
tasks.description: Polish `/issue/:number/session/:sessionId` so the page reads top-to-bottom as Mohist prompts followed by Coder responses and resulting output. The final page should foreground speaker labels, collapsed reasoning, compact changed-file output, useful empty/error states, and avoid workflow-dashboard or event-log presentation.
acceptanceCriteria: Mohist prompt cards render as user-side messages with prompt kind, readable summary, sent time, and collapsed full prompt disclosure
Coder text renders as assistant prose with reasoning collapsed by default
Each assistant turn surfaces resulting file changes as compact transcript output when available
Session header shows issue/session/stage/status context without becoming a workflow dashboard
Loading, waiting-for-activity, empty-history, legacy-missing-prompt, API-error, completed, failed, live, finalizing, and stale states are visually distinct
The page contains no composer, continue-conversation affordance, stop/steer controls, or stage-control dashboard elements
Frontend tests cover speaker structure, collapsed reasoning, file-change output, and state rendering
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes semantic tool rendering from T-004 and canonical metadata from T-002 to complete the opencode-style reading experience.

tasks.title: Verify end-to-end transcript quality
tasks.description: Add focused regression coverage and run final verification for the normalized transcript experience. The tests should model realistic active and historical sessions that previously produced orphan unknown/running cards, noisy context logs, or unreadable file-change output.
acceptanceCriteria: Regression fixtures cover pending plus update tool events, update-only events, no-id correlation, internal lifecycle events, context bursts, bash output, apply_patch, edit/write, reasoning, and multi-turn prompts
Tests prove completed tools appear once with stable name, title, and terminal status after refresh
Tests prove live updates do not create duplicate or orphan tool cards before canonical refetch
Tests prove context gathering is grouped and file changes are visible as compact transcript output
Tests prove raw input/output remains accessible behind explicit disclosure
Tests pass: cd packages/cli && npm test
Build passes: cd packages/cli && npm run build
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Final verification consumes all earlier outputs. Keep fixtures realistic but local to existing backend/API/frontend test suites unless a shared fixture location already exists.
